data.name: From Ashes To Glory
data.detailed_description:
FORGED IN BLOOD.

You wake up in chains. The crowd roars. The gate opens. You have one choice — fight, or die.

Step into the arena as a captured slave forced into brutal gladiatorial combat. Master a deep turn-based combat system where every decision matters: read your opponent, manage your stamina, choose your distance, and strike at the right moment.

KEY FEATURES

  • Tactical Range Combat — Distance is everything. Move in for a killing blow, retreat to recover, or bait your enemy into a fatal mistake.

  • Three Attack Types — Heavy, Normal, and Quick attacks each balance damage, speed, and stamina cost differently.

  • Dodge System — Time your evasion perfectly. A perfect dodge grants a deadly counter window. Mistime it, and pay in blood.

  • 4 Skill Trees — Build your gladiator your way: raw Strength, unbreakable Vitality, lethal Agility, or cunning Intelligence.

  • Warriors from Seven Continents — Face dwarves, mages, pirates, knights, and beasts. Each enemy is a puzzle to solve.

  • The Bet Arena — Place wagers on AI duels and earn your way to better equipment.

  • A Story of Vengeance — Survive the arena. Uncover the truth. Find the shadow that haunts your past.

Are you ready to bleed for freedom?

data.short_description: A dark, turn-based medieval arena RPG. You are a slave forced to fight. Master range, stamina, and timing-based dodges. Choose your weapon, build your skills, and face warriors from seven continents. Every fight is a puzzle. Every mistake costs blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Directx
  • VR Support: Yok
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
